# Multimodal and Speech Systems Engineering

> Build and evaluate applications that see, listen and speak in Arabic and English, and choose their design on measured quality, latency and cost. SDAIA Academy course AE-408, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 19,805 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Seeing](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day1.md): Vision-language models that return validated fields grounded in the photo; sessions: How a vision-language model sees, Structured extraction from photos, Grounding answers in pixels, Arabic text and hidden instructions; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day1.html; about 5,274 tokens
- [Day 2: Listening](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day2.md): Speech recognition measured by dialect, channel and code-switching, with explicit normalisation; sessions: From waveform to text, Normalisation decides the error rate, Dialects and code-switching, Streaming and silence; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day2.html; about 4,400 tokens
- [Day 3: Speaking](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day3.md): A bilingual voice booking line with read-back, turn-taking and tool calls in a latency budget; sessions: Synthesis and read-back, Cascaded versus speech-to-speech, Turn-taking and interruption, Tool calls during speech; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day3.html; about 4,331 tokens
- [Day 4: Evaluating and choosing](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day4.md): Test sets, simulated callers, the decision record and the data-handling note; sessions: Multimodal test sets, Simulated callers, Choosing by quality, latency and cost, Voice, faces and consent; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/day4.html; about 4,418 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/capstone.md): The Heritage Trails booking line and photo-reporting service, defended live on an unseen call and photo; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/slides/capstone.html; about 808 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: One question, three resolutions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D1_1_resolution_tokens.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Validated incident fields](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D1_2_incident_fields.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Boxes and invented objects](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D1_3_grounding_boxes.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Signage and an injected instruction](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D1_4_signage_injection.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Two recognisers, 50 clips](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D2_1_two_recognisers.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Rules before rates](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D2_2_normalisation.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Slices with intervals](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D2_3_dialect_slices.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Text on silence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D2_4_streaming_silence.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Read-back that callers understand](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D3_1_readback.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Where the time goes](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D3_2_latency_trace.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: Tune the end of a turn](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D3_3_end_of_turn.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: A confirmed booking tool](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D3_4_booking_tool.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Sixty items with coverage](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D4_1_test_set.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Twenty simulated calls](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D4_2_simulated_callers.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: The decision record](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D4_3_decision_record.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: The data-handling note](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ae-408/labs/D4_4_consent_note.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
